content: Fix the broken auth flow in src/auth/login.ts. You must update the corresponding test file in tests/auth/login.test.ts and you must run the full test suite before committing. The change must include a fallback for the legacy session cookie path that requires a valid CSRF token. Make sure the fix doesn't break the existing OAuth integration. Also, you must add a comment explaining why we keep both code paths and you must run npm run lint:fix afterwards.
